units.source_scale_reason: Guides are the accepted paintings at their accepted scale; every video frame keeps one fixed extraction scale and anchor.

visual_review.notes: Reviewed every take on contact sheets. Idle v1 every second frame (glance and baton lift); move v2 one gait cycle with the batons low and the chain hanging (v1 lost 91 plates); attack v1 raises the near hook, lunges and lashes the far hook to full reach, then recovers; hit v1 flinch to recovery, quiet tail cut; defend v1 crosses the hooks and sinks into a wide crouch; cast v1 raises both batons overhead with the chain taut and lowers them; death v1 sinks to the knees and topples onto his side, corpse with batons and chain in front of him.
